name: Hermanos Marquez Mexican Restaurant
tagline: Tex-Mex and big breakfast tacos on South College Avenue, open every morning at 7.
about: Hermanos Marquez is a longtime Bryan favorite with a new name. It used to be Mi Pueblito.
It's a family-owned spot for Tex-Mex, and it's busiest at breakfast, when you can build your breakfast tacos however you like.
